title: Two weeks at Ronnie Scott's in London
summary: From Japan she went via New York to London for two weeks at Ronnie Scott's with English backing musicians, and saw Max Jones. She says she is not as close to the English as to the French.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Then I left there and come right on back to New York and went on to London.
Oh you did. You went to Johnny Dankworth's?
No, I went to Ronny Scott's.
Oh, Ronny Scott's, sure, that's right. And then you were there what, two weeks?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Yes.
How was that?
That was wonderful.
You've got a lot of friends in London, haven't you?
Yes.
Not as many as France, maybe?
Well, I'm not as close.
Well, they're not as demonstrative, the English, as the French. But you saw Max Jones and people like that, didn't you?
Yeah.
Well, that was nice. You did well. I know you did well.
Yeah.
Who was accompanying you?
I don't know. I got the names down. And they were good.
Were they? They were English boys?
Oh yeah.
Not Bruce Turner?
No.
It doesn't matter. Well, that's nice.
